exposure: fetal presentation (breech presentation vs. vertex/cephalic presentation)
outcome: fetal heart rate (FHR) during labor and expulsion
duration of different stages of labor
FHR with high risk of acidosis
cohort: 239 patients with term fetuses attempting vaginal delivery (106 with breech presentation and 133 with vertex presentation) between 2014 and 2017.
finding: During attempted vaginal delivery, breech presentation was associated with more frequent oxytocin use, slower average dilatation rates, and a higher incidence of FHR with high risk of acidosis compared to vertex presentation.
